Stop Dreaming. Start Doing. ⚡

DayDone is more than just a to-do list; it's your personal momentum builder. Designed for those who crave clarity and consistency, Day Done helps you turn overwhelming goals into manageable daily habits. Whether you're tracking a morning gym session or a deep-work sprint, Day Done keeps your "chain" going.

The All-In-One Solution for Your Day

Whether you are looking for a comprehensive Daily Planner to organize your morning or a reliable Habit Tracker to build lasting change, DayDone is designed for you. It combines the power of a versatile To-do List with the intelligence of a Productivity App, acting as your personal Routine Builder to help you master your time. Beyond just a Task Manager, Day Done serves as a long-term Goal Tracker, allowing you to see the big picture while managing the details. With our integrated Schedule Planner and Simple Calendar view, you can say goodbye to chaos and hello to a life of consistent achievement.

Why DayDone?

Most planners are too complex. Day Done is built on the principle of Simple Productivity. We provide the visual cues you need to see your progress, without the clutter that slows you down.

Key Features

Intuitive Task Management: Add, edit, and organize tasks with just a few taps. Home Screen Widgets: Access your day planner instantly. View your daily tasks, check off completed ones and track the progress directly from your home screen without opening the app. Powerful Routines: Set tasks to repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or on your own custom interval (e.g., "Every 3 days"). Consistency Heatmaps: Visualize your discipline over the last 52 weeks with our high-fidelity Activity Map. Smart Insights: Compare your performance this week versus last. Discover your productivity peaks and keep your completion rate high. Streaks & Records: Challenge yourself to beat your "Personal Best" streak. Don't break the chain! 🔥 Beautiful Icons & UI: Minimalist design with a focus on ease of use and dark-mode compatibility. Secure Cloud Backup: Never lose your data. Keep your history safe forever.

Privacy First

Your data belongs to you. We offer simple account management and a transparent privacy policy, ensuring your routines stay private. Download DayDone today and start building the life you've planned.
